description:
A hard puzzle cube of winding arrows. Free the pink one.

Cubit is a cube covered in winding arrows. Tap one and it slides off the cube, unless another arrow is in its way. Dig the pink one out before your lives run out.

Levels start at 10×10 per face with about a hundred arrows and grow to 18×18, and the pink arrow sits deeper every level. Arrows wrap over the edges onto the next face, so turn the cube, zoom in and plan ahead.

Ways to play

  • An endless campaign with five modes, from Zen (no lives, no timer) to Expert (one bump and it's over)
  • Clean mode: just a see-through glass cube in your colours
  • A daily cube and a weekly challenge, the same for everyone, each with its own board
  • Puzzle packs: hand-picked cubes from tiny to monstrous
  • Free roam: any cube from 2×2 to 18×18
  • Optional full clear: every arrow off, pink last

And

  • Par for every cube, badges, XP, a daily streak and colourways you earn
  • Race a ghost of the leader's run on the daily and weekly cubes
  • Powerups, all switchable, and hints earned by playing well
  • Leave mid-level and pick it up later
  • Optional global rankings, verified by replaying every run on the server
  • Accessibility: striped target, left-handed layout, heavier arrows

No ads, no accounts, and no tracking. The network is used only if you turn on rankings or the update check.
